title: Data Engineer (LATAM)
description:
Join to apply for the Data Engineer (LATAM) role at Lateral Group

6 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Data Engineer (LATAM) role at Lateral Group

About The Company
Lateral stands for technology excellence.

About The Company
Lateral is a profitable, award-winning design and technology company with over 20 years of experience launching bold ventures and transforming businesses. A globally distributed team of 200+ experts united by a shared purpose: the continuous pursuit of quality. Our clients come to us for results, quality and craft - and stay because we keep raising the bar.

We do things differently at Lateral
Our mission is simple: design and build great products .
What sets us apart isn’t just the talent of our team - it’s the way we work: We Have A Bias For Action & Results. We are doers - we spot the gaps, connect the dots, anticipate what’s around the corner and take action. We move fast, stay focused, and let the results - not the effort - speak for themselves. We Work On Time, On Budget, On Quality. Discipline is our edge - a commitment we make to each other, to our clients, and to the standards we hold ourselves to. We Care Deeply. Care Is A Competitive Advantage. Every detail matters. Every design, every line of code, every decision. Thoughtful by default. We Do Things Right - Because It’s the Right Thing to Do. Right over easy. Integrity isn’t up for negotiation. We hold the bar high even when no one’s watching. We take pride in doing great work the right way - not the easy way. We Keep Improving. The best teams keep improving and we’re never done learning. We iterate. We reflect on what’s working and what’s not. Feedback fuels us, we receive it openly, and adapt quickly. Progress over perfection. We’re Obsessed With Agility, Not The Agile Manifesto. We don’t chase dogma or rituals - we chase momentum. We adapt processes to fit problems, not the other way around. We Take Ownership. Everyone leads something here. You will have room to run with ideas, and the trust to execute. That trust is built on how you show up: thinking things through, sweating the details, and following through.

What You’ll Do
We are committed to building a scalable, secure, and high-quality data ecosystem that empowers our ML scientists and ensures the integrity of our medical imaging solutions. As a Data Engineer at Lateral, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our AI capabilities through a variety of critical tasks:

  • Pipeline Design and Implementation: You will design and implement scalable, secure pipelines for transferring and storing imaging and biomarker data (DICOM to S3, multimodal integration).
  • Data Automation and Quality: Your responsibilities will include automating data anonymization, validation, and quality checks to reduce manual intervention.
  • System Optimization: You will optimize and scale the data cataloging system (currently using DynamoDB), enabling performant querying and downstream use by ML teams.
  • Compliance and Governance: You will support data governance and compliance, including HIPAA/PHI-sensitive workflows across imaging and biomarker modalities.
  • Analytics and Tooling: You will enable analytics and insight generation from large datasets — building tooling to allow quick querying, statistics, and cohort slicing (e.g., by site, modality, etc.).
  • ML Dataset Preparation: You will prepare and deliver ML-ready datasets, including site-based sourcing and assignment to experimental splits.
  • Strategic Collaboration: You will collaborate cross-functionally with ML scientists, product, and data stakeholders to map and evolve the future of Ezra’s innovation data ecosystem.

What We’re Looking For
We’re seeking builders who love taming complexity and making high-quality data available at scale. You’ll thrive in this role if you bring:

  • 3+ years building production data pipelines and architectures, ideally in cloud environments like AWS; strong candidates with less experience also considered.
  • Strong Python skills, with experience in tools like boto3, pydicom, pandas, and airflow or equivalent workflow orchestrators.
  • Familiarity with healthcare data formats (DICOM, HL7) and privacy-sensitive workflows (anonymization, de-identification, auditability).
  • Experience with NoSQL or semi-structured databases (e.g. DynamoDB) and their performance tuning.
  • Understanding of data validation, observability, and quality assurance best practices.
  • Comfort collaborating across engineering, research, and product teams to understand needs and deliver high-quality data products.
  • Ability to reason about system scale, performance tradeoffs, and long-term maintainability of complex pipelines.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience supporting ML teams directly with clean, well-versioned training datasets.
  • Familiarity with at least one of the major distributed computing frameworks (e.g. PySpark, Ray, Dask)
  • Exposure to data governance and compliance frameworks (HIPAA, GDPR, etc.).
  • Experience integrating multimodal or time-series data sources.
  • Prior work with medical or life sciences datasets.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Real Impact: You’ll work on meaningful products that make a measurable difference - from healthcare and commerce to sustainability and next-gen tech.
  • Remote-First, Office Friendly: Work from wherever you’re most productive - whether that’s your home, a co-working space, or one of our offices. We’re a remote-first company, but if you’re near an office, you’re welcome to drop in, collaborate in person, or work onsite regularly.

We prioritize async collaboration, respect your time zone, and focus on outcomes over hours.

  • An Outstanding Team: Talented, kind, and hard-working people who care deeply about their craft - and about each other. No egos. No politics. Just professionals doing their best work.
  • Growth: You’ll be supported in growing your craft, exploring new paths, and stepping into greater responsibility - at your own pace
  • A Culture of Excellence: We care deeply about doing the right thing - for our clients, our team, and ourselves. No burnout. No crunch. Just high-quality work, delivered sustainably.
  • Variety & Stability: We’re profitable, independent, and over a decade strong. Yet every project brings a fresh challenge. You’ll never be bored here.

This Role Might Not Be for You
We want to respect your time by being clear about what this role isn’t. You should skip this opportunity if:

  • You prefer well defined structure. If you gravitate towards a clear hierarchy, well defined roles and swim lanes, you may find our self-managed style challenging.
  • Distributed work isn’t your thing. If you find async communication, design documentation and being proactive without a manager nearby difficult, our setup won’t suit you.
  • Feedback doesn\'t excite you. We’re obsessed with quality and believe in continuous improvement. That means we give feedback that’s sometimes nitpicky. If refining the work until it’s excellent feels over the top, you are likely going to find working here frustrating.
  • Change makes you uncomfortable. We’re scaling and maturing. That means not everything is perfect yet. Priorities shift. Processes evolve. If ambiguity is uncomfortable, this may feel bumpy.

However, If this sounds like fuel, we’d love to talk!

How to apply and what to expect in the interview process
Our hiring process is structured as a sequence of steps. Moving forward is based on how well the previous step goes. This helps us stay focused, fair, and respectful of everyone’s time.

We will always:

  • Let you know clearly what the next step is
  • Share updates and feedback wherever possible
  • Invite questions if anything feels unclear

Not everyone progresses through every stage. That doesn’t mean you’re not great at what you do. Sometimes it’s about timing, team fit, or simply what we’re looking for at the moment.

  1. Step 1: Express Your Interest
  2. If this sounds like your kind of team and you’re ready to bring your craft to Lateral, we want to hear from you.
  3. Please send us:
  4. Your resume
  5. A short note about what excites you about this role
  6. Links to your work: GitHub/ Code snippets, portfolio, architecture /design docs, blog posts, or anything that shows us how you think and build

Please don’t include anything sensitive or proprietary. If you’re sharing team projects, let us know what your specific contributions were. We review every application with care. If there’s a fit, we’ll reach out to schedule next steps.

Step 2: Talent Partner Conversation
Purpose: A structured discussion with our People Experience team to delve into your career trajectory, motivations, and alignment with Lateral\'s values.

What to Expect:

  • In-depth questions about your past experiences and decision-making processes.
  • Exploration of your career goals and how they align with the role.
  • Discussion about our company culture, availability, compensation and other logistics
  • Motivators and demotivators.
  • Your life outside coding.

Step 3: Technical interview
Purpose: Assess your technical proficiency and problem-solving abilities.

Format: A collaborative session with our engineering team, focusing on real-world scenarios relevant to the role.

What to Expect:

  • Problem-solving exercises/questions that mirror tasks you\'d encounter in the position.
  • Discussions around your approach, reasoning, and solutions.

Preparation Tips:

  • Practice articulating your thought process clearly and concisely.
  • Be prepared to discuss in depth past projects and the technologies used.

Step 4: Client interview
Purpose: Evaluate how well you collaborate, communicate, and consult with external stakeholders.

Format:

A live conversation with one of our client-side collaborators

What to Expect:

  • Discussion around business and technical challenges from the client’s perspective.
  • Opportunity to explain your approach, gather requirements, ask clarifying questions, and articulate tradeoffs.
  • Evaluation of how clearly you communicate solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preparation Tips:

  • Once client details are shared, educate yourself with their business and potential challenges
  • Review past experiences where you’ve had to communicate complex ideas clearly.
  • Reflect on your ability to lead conversations, guide decision-making, and build trust across different audiences.

Step 5: Operational interview
Purpose: Understand your approach to prioritizing, collaborating, shipping, and iterating.

What to expect:

  • How you prioritize and break down work.
  • How you collaborate across disciplines.
  • How you handle blockers, feedback, and iteration.

Preparation Tips:

  • Pick 1-2 meaningful projects you led or heavily contributed to.
  • Walk through your process: what worked, what didn’t, what you’d do differently.
  • Think about how you manage time, scope, and changing requirements.

Step 6: Reference Checks
Purpose: We believe references are about understanding, not just validation. We do not look for perfection, but to understand patterns, strengths, and context. We use them to learn how to support you best.

What to Expect: we’ll ask you for 2–3 people who’ve worked closely with you. These are often: former managers, senior peers or collaborators, mentors or people you\'ve mentored.

What we ask: We focus on how you’ve grown, where you shine, how you like to be led, and what support sets you up for success. We want practical advice for making this a great fit for you.

Yes, we do backchannels too: We do this when we feel we need more context. We will check with you if there are folks we should avoid reaching out due to confidentiality or other reasons. And here’s our commitment: if anything surprising or unclear comes up in a backchannel, we’ll bring it directly to you. We believe in “no stories without you in the room.” You’ll always get the chance to share your side, context, or clarification.

Step 7: Offer
What Happens: If selected, you\'ll receive a comprehensive offer detailing compensation, and other pertinent information. Our hiring process is designed to be thorough yet respectful, ensuring a mutual fit. We encourage candidates to engage actively, ask questions, and view this as a two-way exploration.

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences.

This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).

Description

The Countrywide Insurance Product Analytics, Senior Analyst role will be responsible for leveraging advanced analytics to measure the success of insurance product countrywide programs.

This role will play a key part in:

  • Understanding the expected changes and corresponding impacts of various insurance product initiatives
  • Translating this information into analytical requirements to inform the set up of robust analytical frameworks that enable stakeholders to quickly understand results and trends
  • Identifying opportunities to enhance both new initiatives and existing programs.

This role will also be responsible for evaluating the ongoing health of various metrics for the current book of business and proactively raising and understanding key drivers of any new trends observed.

Key Responsibilities

  • Independently conduct analysis of current countrywide programs to understand and quantify the success of the program while identifying areas of opportunity for future enhancements related to growth and profitability.
  • Closely work and collaborate with the Insurance Product team to align on analytical requirements and measures of success for both new and ongoing initiatives.
  • Build out comprehensive monitoring frameworks that provide insights around current results and trends. Leverage these findings to provide recommendations on both product and strategy that will have positive impacts on growth, retention, and profitability.
  • Consistently demonstrate curiosity by proposing new ideas for analysis and leveraging the resulting insights to show alignment with or opportunities within current and future strategies.
  • Conduct competitor research using various tools and sources to keep a proactive pulse on industry results and trends that could inform internal decisions.
  • Effectively communicate insights and recommendations to the Insurance Product team and other key stakeholders (including senior leadership) by demonstrating advanced influencing and storytelling skills.

Requirements

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in personal lines property or auto insurance products; experience in both is preferred
  • Advanced analytical thinking and comfort in evaluating the success of various countrywide insurance product programs against targets
  • Ability to write complex SQL queries for data extraction, manipulation, and analysis
  • Experience in the end-to-end process of building, evaluating, and refining predictive models, with a focus on improving model performance and interpretability using Python or R

  • Advanced organizational and time management skills, capable of working with high autonomy on complex initiatives while meeting deadlines

title: Data Analyst - Compliance
description:
Direct message the job poster from Kraken

Overview

We’re hiring Data Analysts to join our Compliance Enterprise Client Data Office team, working remotely. This role focuses on building and enhancing compliance dashboarding, analytics, and insights. The candidate must be passionate about creating dashboards that deliver clear, actionable insights, as this will be the main focus of the role.

The team will design scalable compliance dashboards, analytics, and metrics, architect automated pipelines and audit-ready regulatory reports, and translate plain-language business or regulatory requests into precise data models. You’ll partner with leaders across Compliance, Risk, and other stakeholders to strengthen Kraken’s compliance posture and ensure regulators and executives have visibility into accurate, meaningful insights. Contextualizing data within the broader business and risk landscape, and communicating those insights to both technical and non-technical audiences, will be essential.

You will also provide ad-hoc support as needed, including managing data requests, assisting with regulatory reporting, supporting automation and peer code reviews, and developing tactical solutions that free up Product and Engineering teams for long-term improvements. The ability to juggle multiple projects in a fully remote environment and leverage AI to create scalable frameworks will be key to success.

Ultimately, this is a critical role shaping Kraken’s compliance and client data strategy, aligning data practices with ambitious business objectives, and navigating the evolving regulatory landscape with rigor, creativity, and precision.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain high-quality data sources in partnership with Data and Engineering teams.
  • Build key datasets and data pipelines using Python and ETL frameworks (e.g., Airflow).
  • Design and automate reports, dashboards, and compliance metrics ensuring consistency, accuracy, and actionable insights for business partners across the business.
  • Work closely with Regional Compliance Officers to deliver audit-ready regulatory reports.
  • Build client data dashboards for Executive Leadership, providing insights on trends, KPIs, demographics, and growth opportunities.
  • Monitor and improve client data quality by identifying issues, driving remediations, and coordinating timely resolutions.
  • Automate compliance governance controls and monitoring to ensure processes operate as expected.
  • Provide cross-functional support during peak periods (requirements definition, backlog management, QA triage) to maintain delivery timelines.
  • Develop ad-hoc compliance solutions to enable Product Development and Engineering teams to focus on long-term improvements.
  • Support ad-hoc data requests for audits, exams, risk assessments, and day-to-day business needs.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in data analysis and data management
  • 2+ years of experience in Compliance and Regulatory Reporting
  • Advanced knowledge of SQL, scripting languages and database concepts with a track record of data analysis
  • Expert in Python for data analysis, automation, and building scalable applications, with proficiency in libraries and frameworks for complex workflows
  • Hands-on experience with AWS, Airflow, Cursor, and BI tools such as QuickSight or Superset
  • Experience using compliance and investigation tools (e.g., Hummingbird, Moody’s RDC, Chainalysis, Elliptic) to support regulatory reporting, monitoring, and risk analysis
  • Ability to translate ambiguous regulatory requests into technical requirements
  • Familiarity with data warehouse development and best practices
  • Ability to clearly present reports and dashboards to Executives
  • Belief in Kraken’s cypherpunk, libertarian values as outlined in Kraken’s Tentaclements document
  • Must be based in LATAM, Europe, or India, and fluent in English

Nice to Have

  • Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Analytics, Data Science, or related field
  • Knowledge of AML/FCC, Sanctions, KYC, MiCA, MiFID, or Data Governance regulations
  • Passionate about crypto with knowledge of emerging trends and tokens beyond blue chips

A missão desse cargo é fornecer um ambiente seguro e de apoio onde os pacientes possam explorar suas emoções, pensamentos e experiências por meio de diferentes modalidades artísticas. A missão do Arteterapeuta é capacitar os pacientes a descobrir seu potencial criativo, promover a autenticidade e facilitar o processo de transformação pessoal e emocional.

  • Utilizar técnicas de improvisação e expressão corporal para explorar questões emocionais e relacionais

  • Encorajar a reflexão sobre o processo criativo e suas conexões com a vida cotidiana
  • Promover atividades artísticas colaborativas, onde os pacientes trabalham juntos em projetos coletivos
  • Facilitar sessões de compartilhamento onde os participantes possam discutir e apreciar o trabalho uns dos outros de forma respeitosa e encorajadora

Missão do time de Marketing Analytics:

A área de Marketing Analytics tem como principal objetivo monitorar e otimizar a performance das campanhas de mídia, integrando dados de diversas fontes e fornecendo análises que apoiem decisões estratégicas. Buscamos alguém com forte capacidade analítica, domínio técnico em manipulação de dados (com foco em SQL e BigQuery) e conhecimento em mídia paga (Google, Meta, programática, entre outros).

Como é ser um(a) Analista de Marketing Analytics:

Essa pessoa será responsável por acompanhar e interpretar os principais KPIs das campanhas, gerar hipóteses e testes para melhoria de performance, propor insights acionáveis e garantir a visibilidade dos resultados para os stakeholders. As principais atividades a serem executadas serão:

  • Realizar análises profundas de canais, audiências, criativos e jornada de conversão;
  • Analisar o desempenho das campanhas de mídia digital;
  • Criar e manter dashboards automatizados em ferramentas como Looker Studio ou similares;
  • Manipular grandes volumes de dados usando SQL e BigQuery;
  • Levantar hipóteses com base em dados e validar com testes A/B ou análises comparativas;
  • Apoiar a definição de metas e KPIs junto aos times de marketing e negócios;
  • Trabalhar próximo das áreas de mídia, CRM, branding e produto para priorizar iniciativas com base em impacto;
  • Acompanhar e interpretar métricas de atribuição, CAC, LTV, ROI e outras métricas relevantes;
  • Criar documentação clara e objetiva dos aprendizados das análises realizadas.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência prévia em Marketing Analytics, mídia de performance ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio de SQL e experiência com BigQuery;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de visualização de dados como Looker Studio, Power BI ou Tableau;
  • Sólido conhecimento de KPIs de marketing e funis de conversão;
  • Capacidade de traduzir dados em histórias claras e estratégicas para diferentes públicos;
  • Experiência com campanhas de mídia paga será considerada um diferencial.

O que aumentam suas chances:

  • Experiência com modelagem de atribuição ou marketing mix modeling;
  • Conhecimento em Python ou R para análises estatísticas;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de automação de marketing;
  • Experiência em ambientes com squads multidisciplinares.

Jornada de Trabalho:

  • 8 horas diárias + 1h de intervalo | Escala: 5x2 | Segunda a Sexta.

Job Title: Process Lead / Senior Appraisal Analyst – HELOCs and Mortgage

Location: Atlanta, GA, or anywhere in the US – Must be willing to work EST or CST

In the Process Lead role, you will review the Desktop Exterior and Desktop Interior assessments to evaluate and sign off a property's valuation for a large bank in the US. When taking a decision about a property’s valuation, you will ensure compliance with Federal/State laws to ensure that loans that are secured with real estate are protected with adequate collateral value.

In the role of Process Lead, you will execute transactions as per prescribed guidelines and timelines, review and validate the inputs from other team members, support your manager in training activities, daily operations reviews, and help in escalation resolution with the objective to meet service level agreement targets for the specific process within the guidelines, policies, and norms of Infosys.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Review collateral to ensure compliance with Federal/state law and that loans secured with real estate have adequate collateral value.
  • Successfully use critical thinking and analytical skills to review collaterals.
  • Develop and maintain a strong understanding of Mortgage Lending products, policies, processes, and their collateral requirements.
  • Obtain required collateral documentation per program requirements from internal clients, external clients, vendors, and third-party sources.
  • Perform a detailed review of all collateral documentation to ensure that loans meet portfolio and investor guidelines.
  • Identify and escalate collateral issues to the appropriate teammate for further evaluation.
  • Consistently communicate with other departments and sales to ensure pipeline metrics and quality guidelines are met.
  • Adhere to all compliance regulations and controls.
  • Develop and maintain positive working relationships with co-workers, internal and external clients, business partners, and vendors.

Qualifications

Basic

  • Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education.
  • At least 4 years of relevant work experience

Qualifications Preferred

  • Three to five years of mortgage or consumer lending experience
  • Three years of continuous collateral review and approval experience
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, in relating to internal and external clients
  • Demonstrates proficiency in basic computer applications such as Microsoft Office software products
  • Ability to travel, occasionally overnight
  • Understanding of appraisal compliance and generally accepted appraisal rules
  • Experience with using appraisal and market evaluation tools
  • Demonstrates proficiency in mortgage automated processing systems
  • Basic knowledge of bank services and products

Note : Applicants for employment in the U.S. must possess work authorization, which does not require sponsorship by the employer for a visa (H1B or otherwise).

The job entails sitting as well as working at a computer for extended periods. Should be able to communicate by telephone, email, or face-to-face.

About Us

Infosys BPM Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Infosys Limited (NYSE: INFY), provides end-to-end transformative business process management (BPM) services for its clients across the globe. The company’s integrated IT and BPM solutions approach enables it to unlock business value across industries and service lines and address business challenges for its clients. Utilizing innovative business excellence frameworks, ongoing productivity improvements, process reengineering, automation, and cutting-edge technology platforms, Infosys BPM enables its clients to achieve their cost reduction objectives, improve process efficiencies, enhance effectiveness, and deliver superior customer experience.

Infosys BPM has 44 delivery centers in 16 countries spread across 5 continents, with 59,443 employees from 108 nationalities, as of March, 2025.

The company has been consistently ranked among the leading BPM companies globally and has received over 60 awards and recognitions in the last 5 years, from key industry bodies and associations like the Outsourcing Center, SSON, and GSA, among others. Infosys BPM also has very robust people practices, as substantiated by various HR-specific awards. The company has consistently been ranked among the top employers based on HR practices. The company’s senior leaders contribute widely to industry forums as BPM strategists.

Infosys is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, spouse of a protected veteran, or disability.

  • Desenvolver e implementar modelos preditivos, sistemas de recomendação e análises estatísticas para otimizar produtos e processos;

Será considerado um diferencial

  • Participação em projetos ponta a ponta, desde a concepção até o monitoramento pós-deploy;

Senior Specialist, Employee Relations - LATAM

Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We enable businesses to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. Our team works asynchronously, around the world, with fully remote positions. We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to help us build a best-in-class HR platform.

If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

What this job can offer you

As a critical extension of our clients’ HR teams, we navigate and advise on global employment with speed, expertise, and precision. The Lifecycle team focuses on elevating HR practices through technology and enriching customer experiences in 80+ countries. Your work will influence our compliance coverage, customer journeys, and operational capacity. You will help shape the future of work by ensuring fast, intuitive, and impactful interactions for organizations employing anyone, anywhere — compliantly.

The Senior Lifecycle Specialist, Employee Relations & Transitions independently manages all employee exits for Remote's external employees with a focus on legal compliance, high quality service and delightful customer experience. The specialist also provides first-level Employee Relations support, guiding clients through workplace concerns and coordinating appropriate resources. As part of the Lifecycle team, you will drive process improvements in line with Remote's strategic goals and values.

What you bring

  • Extensive experience as an HR Advisor or HR Business Partner with generalist HR competencies across the employee lifecycle.
  • Tertiary qualifications in HR/labour relations/employment law are a plus.
  • Experience independently managing voluntary and involuntary exits with care, sensitivity and legal compliance; providing comprehensive HR advice on employment laws across jurisdictions.
  • Understanding of employee relations principles, progressive discipline, and workplace investigations.
  • Ability to interpret and apply industrial instruments, analyze complex HR issues, and communicate recommendations clearly to clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Superior communication, influencing, conflict management and negotiation skills; ability to lead difficult conversations with professionalism and confidentiality.
  • Business-level English (advanced), with additional languages a plus.
  • Aptitude for innovating and optimizing processes, including automation and best practices.
  • Attention to data integrity and thorough record-keeping.
  • Tech-savvy and able to collaborate asynchronously using evolving systems.
  • Ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced, remote, international team; willing to work flexible hours.
  • Proactive, self-motivated with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and resolve complex end-to-end employee exits across multiple international jurisdictions with minimal supervision; prioritize a superior offboarding experience for Remote's clients and employees.
  • Provide guidance on termination, resignation and transfer procedures, contracts, and redundancy processes, ensuring legal compliance and best practices.
  • Independently lead meetings with clients and external employees (e.g., workforce reductions, administrative hearings, negotiations, settlements) and deliver termination outcomes.
  • Navigate complex terminations to achieve positive outcomes, coordinating with multiple stakeholders with competing interests.
  • Liaise with internal and external stakeholders to ensure compliance in offboarding activities and audits (payroll, legal counsel, government bodies, unions).
  • Draft and tailor termination documents with accuracy, maintaining privacy and confidentiality.
  • Process offboarding in Remote's HRIS, collaborating with Customer Success, Legal, Payroll, Benefits, Time and Attendance, and others to ensure correct administration.
  • Provide mentorship to junior team members and act as a first point of informal escalation on employee relations matters.
  • Guide clients in navigating Remote's Employee Relations resources and complex workplace scenarios.
  • Assess workplace concerns, identify key facts and applicable laws, and determine potential paths forward.
  • Serve as a trusted resource on employee relations, ensuring appropriate handling of complex cases.
  • Advocate for process improvements, automation, product development, and improved customer and employee experience in offboarding and employee relations.
  • Determine methods and standards on new assignments, applying judgment to achieve results aligned with Lifecycle and Remote needs.

Practical details

  • You'll report to: Manager, Employee Lifecycle, Employee Relations & Transitions
  • Team: Lifecycle, Employee Relations & Transitions
  • Location: LATAM
  • Start date: As soon as possible

Remote Compensation Philosophy

Remote’s total rewards philosophy aims to ensure fair compensation and competitive benefits in all locations. We pay above in-location rates and hire globally. Our salary bands are geo-based to reflect geographic pay differentials and market demands.

The base salary range for this full-time position is $41,900 to $94,300 USD. Actual pay depends on location, skills, experience, and business needs. The range may change over time. See the handbook for full benefits information.

Note: compensation changes for internal moves are reviewed by the Total Rewards & People Enablement team on a case-by-case basis.

  • Interview with team member and Legal team
  • Interview with Senior Manager and Director

Remote accepts applications on an ongoing basis.

How you’ll plan your day (and life)

We work async at Remote, so you can plan your schedule around your life. Your life-work balance is important, and you will be encouraged to put yourself and your family first.

If this sounds like a fit, apply now!

  • Submit your application and CV in English.

We encourage applicants from all backgrounds. If you need an accommodation during the interview process, please request one from your recruiter. We are an equal employment opportunity employer and support diversity and inclusion.

About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients. Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across e-commerce marketplaces, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability. What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and earned recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About The Role

As an Editor at Darkroom, your primary duty will be to develop and assist in the development of marketing collateral, including video content and organic content. Our Editors add immense value to our client's work through native content and strategies. The ideal candidate is someone who is passionate about using their editing skills to tell a compelling story and help our customers grow their businesses.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, and Spain.

Who You Are

  • Experience creating platform native content (including video content and organic content), especially IG Reels, Meta ads, and TikTok viral video campaigns

  • Strong communication skills

What You'll Do

  • You will be editing UGC-style videos in a variety of content formats
  • Develop and execute thumb-stopping social media video edits, layer audio seamlessly and overlay text that drives key brand messaging
  • Brainstorm inventive edits and hooks that drive engagement, leverage new formats
  • Stay current on all social media platforms, ad offerings, content publishers, tools, trends, and best practices

  • Setting up projects for edit staff

  • Mastering deliverables and archiving projects

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable. We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics. If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. title: Chemistry Specialist
description:
Overview

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we\'re helping usher in the promise of AI.

Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms. Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

We\'re poised for a period of explosive growth over the next few years.

Role

About the Role: At Innodata, we\'re working with the world\'s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We\'re looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts. We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Chemistry Subject Matter Expert (SME) to contribute to the development and training of AI Large Language Models (LLMs).

As a Chemistry SME, you will play a critical role in guiding AI models to understand complex chemistry concepts, ensuring accuracy, relevance, and contextual understanding in the domain.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with AI researchers, data scientists, and engineers to train, refine, and evaluate Large Language Models with a focus on Chemistry content.
  • Develop high-quality, accurate, and domain-specific datasets, including conceptual explanations, technical documents, research abstracts, and problem-solving content.
  • Review and validate AI-generated content for technical accuracy, clarity, and contextual relevance in the field of Chemistry.
  • Provide expert feedback on model outputs, identify conceptual gaps, and suggest improvements to enhance model learning.
  • Assist in creating and annotating training datasets, including classification, tagging, and contextual labeling of chemistry-related data.
  • Ensure all content meets scientific rigour and is aligned with industry best practices.
  • Stay up to date with the latest advancements in Chemistry and AI to continuously improve training methodologies.

Qualifications

  • Master\'s or PhD in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or related scientific field.
  • Strong theoretical and practical knowledge of chemistry concepts (Organic, Inorganic, Physical, Analytical, Biochemistry, etc.).
  • Prior experience in academic research, technical writing, or teaching is highly desirable.
  • Experience working with data annotation, content development, or training AI models is a plus.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Detail-oriented with a passion for accuracy and scientific precision.
  • Technical Skills (Preferred): Familiarity with AI, Machine Learning, and Large Language Models (LLMs).
  • Experience using annotation tools or content management platforms.
  • Basic knowledge of Python or data handling tools (preferred but not mandatory).
  • Understanding of data quality control processes.

As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment. The assessment is mandatory & non-billable.

As a Customer Success Analyst at Weni by VTEX , you will ensure that clients successfully adopt and extract value from the Weni Platform. You will combine relationship management with hands-on technical knowledge, guiding clients to use the platform effectively and embedding Weni’s solutions into their daily operations.

What you will do

  • Drive Product Adoption: Guide clients through configuration, workflows, and integrations to ensure they fully leverage the Weni Platform.

  • Client Engagement & Expansion: Build strong relationships with clients, including C-Level executives, to identify growth opportunities, negotiate renewals, and promote upsells.

  • Collaboration with Internal Teams: Work closely with Solution Engineering, Product, and Support teams to resolve issues and ensure a smooth client experience.

Who you are

  • You are technically proficient, able to understand platform features, integrations, and workflows, and translate that knowledge into actionable guidance for clients.

  • You have knowledge and/or experience in Retail, Marketplace, Digital Commerce, or Omnichannel, understanding how these areas impact adoption and customer experience.
  • You have experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, or Solution Engineering.
  • You are fluent in English and comfortable communicating with global clients; Spanish is a plus.
  • You are proactive, organized, and driven to help clients succeed with Weni’s solutions.

VTEX (NYSE: VTEX) is the composable and complete commerce platform that delivers more efficiency and less maintenance to organizations seeking to make smarter IT investments and modernize their tech stack. Through our pragmatic composability approach, we empower brands, distributors, and retailers with unparalleled flexibility and comprehensive solutions, enabling them to invest solely in what provides a clear business advantage and boosts profitability. VTEX is trusted by 2,400 global B2C and B2B customers, including Carrefour, Colgate, Motorola, Sony, Stanley Black & Decker, and Whirlpool, having 3,400 active online stores across 43 countries (as of FY ended on December 31, 2024).

Founded in the year 2000, VTEX has a history of being unstoppable. Completely against the odds, VTEX is leading a high-tech industry and positioned above market giants. We are building an extraordinary future with more than 1,300 employees scattered across 25 locations in 16 countries in Latin America, North America, Europe, and Asia. For more information, visit

At VTEX, you will work in a challenge-driven environment and collaborate with amazing peers. If you are powerful individually, join us, and we will be unstoppable together.

About Weni by VTEX

Weni by VTEX is a business unit of VTEX dedicated to enterprise customer experience solutions powered by artificial intelligence, designed for brands and retailers.

With the Weni Platform, we redefine sales and post-sales journeys through hyperautomation and the smart integration of data into conversational channels, delivering faster, more personalized, and more efficient experiences for consumers.

title: Medical Specialist
description:
Overview

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we're helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms. Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

Job title and location

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labelling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment. The assessment is mandatory & non-billable.
  • If interested, kindly share your updated resume at : ******

Additional Details

  • Seniority level: Internship
  • Employment type: Contract
  • Job function: Health Care Provider

title: Inbound Sales Representative
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Inbound Sales Representative role at Toptal .

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary

Our Inbound Sales Representatives connect and engage with prospective clients who originate from inbound leads. They seek new business opportunities by connecting with, and developing relationships with, potential customers and guiding prospective clients throughout the required sales stages. To excel in this position, you need to effectively communicate and collaborate with clients, ensuring they understand the value of our services and how Toptal can support their goals. Our ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, is hungry to exceed sales quotas, and strives to go above and beyond. If you are passionate about sales, innately driven, and results-oriented, this is the perfect opportunity for you to launch your sales career.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities

  • Sales Cycle Management: You will be the initial face of Toptal and support our clients through the required sales stages. As the first point of contact and the initial ‘face’ of Toptal for new clients, you will be responsible for moving these clients forward in the sales process, starting with regularly conducting sales calls. You will be responsible for accurately articulating the benefit of Toptal to potential clients in these calls and managing deal cycles from discovery through close.
  • Client Experience: You will execute a customer-centric approach across all client interactions during pre-defined working hours. You will build rapport with prospective clients, which will require researching clients before outreach and staying on top of industry trends and Toptal competitors.
  • Collaboration with Team Members: You will collaborate with your team to promptly respond to high-volume inbound client inquiries. Communicating via Zoom and Slack is critical to maintaining a high level of collaboration and clear communication within the team.
  • Growth and Development: Our SMB sales team members always look to improve individually and as a team. Being open to and implementing feedback will be critical to achieving success in this role at Toptal.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • The ideal candidate has 1-3 years of B2B sales experience (e.g., Account Executive, Inside Sales, Outside Sales Representative, Account Representative, or related title).
  • Software or tech-related sales experience and education are a plus.
  • Be attentive to client needs. You will be required to be fully available during your working hours to take client calls.
  • You are client-centric. You will be working with prospective clients daily, uncovering and resolving clients’ issues through value-based selling.
  • Have a “will-to-win” attitude. You’re looking to not only meet but exceed your quota and are naturally competitive. We provide a base salary plus uncapped commission and want our Client Advisors to make the most out of it!
  • You’re a “learn-it-all.” We are looking for someone who is always looking to grow, strives for improvement, and constantly seeks feedback from peers/leaders. Even as an individual contributor, you seek to share and gain knowledge from those around you.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with your team members.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts. We move quickly, so having exceptional time management skills and the ability to manage a high volume of clients is key to being successful in this role.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Sobre a oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um Tech Lead para integrar nossa equipe. Seu papel será liderar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento do nosso produto de gerenciamento de atendimento (Service Management), construído sobre nossa plataforma low-code. O desafio é guiar o time na criação de uma solução robusta e escalável, promovendo inovação e excelência técnica.

Principais desafios

  • Evoluir nosso UI Builder: Colabore na incrementação do nosso construtor de componentes e páginas. Ele permite criar telas e fluxos completos utilizando todo e qualquer artifício do Vue.js via interface com alguns cliques e poucas linhas de código. Nosso objetivo é trazer a experiência de codar para o UI Builder e no futuro até páginas mais complexas possam ser construídas com ele.
  • Desenvolver nossa solução white label: Colabore na incrementação do nosso motor de criação de plataformas white label, que traz consigo uma série de funcionalidades nativas como autenticação, gerenciamento de usuários, permissões, construtor de formulários, CRUD de tabelas SQL via interface, CSM, entre muitas outras. Isso tudo criando um ambiente isolado para cada cliente e permitindo a customização construindo páginas específicas pra cada um deles.
  • Evolução nosso marketplace de páginas: Já imaginou um cliente ser capaz de desenvolver uma página em Vue tão útil que poderia ser usada por outros clientes da Beyond? Para isso temos o marketplace de interfaces / extensões, que permite publicar, instalar e gerenciar páginas criadas para todo o nosso ecossistema!
  • Expandir nossa biblioteca de componentes: Desenvolva componentes únicos e white label. Como formulários dinâmicos, calendários, gráficos GANTT, listas com integração nativa com APIs etc.
  • Desenvolver soluções de IA e machine learning: Crie fluxos com LLMs suportando funções integradas a serem chamadas em determinados contextos, como a consulta de um dado em um banco de dados. Implemente Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) através da vetorização de dados, buscas por similaridade e integração com LLM.
  • Automatizar com fluxos low-code/no-code: Implemente soluções poderosas usando ferramentas como N8N e ActivePieces, criando fluxos e APIs completas via interface. Além disso desenvolva novas funcionalidades através de nós para serem utilizados por todos os outros desenvolvedores.
  • Contribuir para o open-source: Ajude a tornar nossos produtos open-source, construa uma comunidade ativa e transforme suas ideias em impacto global.

Responsabilidades

  • Liderar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento frontend e backend, utilizando Vue.js, Node.js, Express e MySQL.
  • Definir e documentar arquiteturas escaláveis, garantindo eficiência e segurança.
  • Mentorar e orientar o time de desenvolvimento, promovendo boas práticas.
  • Colaborar com produto, design e stakeholders para alinhar soluções técnicas aos objetivos estratégicos.

  • Supervisionar a utilização de plataformas low-code/no-code para implementação de regras de negócio.
  • Planejar e delegar atividades, equilibrando prazos e inovação tecnológica.

Requisitos e diferenciais

.75% of incentive target for each 1% of revenue attainment up to 50% of quota;

1% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 75% and 100%; and once performance exceeds 100% attainment, incentive rates are at or above 1% for each 1% of attainment with no cap on incentive compensation.

About Pivot Bio:

Fueled by an innovative drive and a deep understanding of microbiology, genomics, crop nutrition and agriculture, Pivot Bio is pioneering game-changing advances in fertilizer technology. As a key member of the Commercial team, the RCAL leads regional agronomy efforts for product performance data generation and sharing, seller agronomic and technical product training, and on-farm grower support. Pivot Bio products aim to deliver a more consistent and reliable source of nitrogen to crops and our Commercial Agronomy team strives to be industry leading nitrogen advisors. The ideal candidate will reside within this region.

  • Manage key 3rd party relationships and trialing efforts within region.
  • Assist sales teams with regional sales representative trainings and customer facing events to provide technical product knowledge and agronomy support.

  • Regularly integrate emerging technology tools for evaluation of products as well as grower demonstrations and support.

Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!
Antes De Avançarmos, é Importante Você Saber Que

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.
O que buscamos?
Estamos em busca de um/uma Tech Writer para fazer parte de nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por traduzir soluções técnicas em conteúdos claros, completos e reutilizáveis, garantindo que times internos, clientes e usuários tenham documentação precisa para tomada de decisão, desenvolvimento, operação e suporte.   • Revisar tecnicamente conteúdos produzidos por terceiros (engenharia/fornecedores) e garantir acurácia e aderência ao padrão
  • Mapear jornadas de usuários internos/externos e escrever how-tos, troubleshooting e FAQs
  • Medir a utilização/impacto da documentação (analytics, feedbacks) e conduzir ciclos de melhoria contínua
  • Coordenar calendário editorial e priorizar backlog de documentação alinhado ao roadmap de produto/projeto
Para Cumprir Esse Desafio, Você Precisa Ter
  • Experiência de mais de 03 anos comprovada como Tech Writer

  • Noções sólidas de APIs REST, OpenAPI/Swagger e integrações entre serviços
  • Capacidade de entrevistar fontes técnicas e transformar complexidade em clareza
  • Organização, atenção a detalhes e habilidade de trabalhar com múltiplos stakeholders

By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group enables us to maximize the use of data and drive AB InBev's digital transformation and organic growth around the world.

We are looking for a talented and passionate Data Engineer to join our growing team. You will use various cutting-edge technologies to develop and maintain data pipelines. If you are detail-oriented and motivated, with excellent organizational skills, we’d like to hear from you.

Core Responsibilities:

  • Support the Data Engineering team lead to ensure the quality and agility of the team activities
  • Work collaboratively and creatively with other data engineers to develop scalable and maintainable data pipelines using the latest technologies and leading industry practices

  • Strong understanding in the modern data storage and evolution (Data Lake, Delta Lake, Lakehouse etc.)
  • Experience working with Big Data frameworks, preferably Databricks etc.

ECOMMERCE MANAGER

Overview

Our mission is to deliver exceptional value and service at an accessible price, driving client success through strategic media buying, optimization, and data-driven forecasting. As an Ecommerce Manager at Common Thread Collective (CTC), you will lead the development of accurate, insight-driven forecasts and ensure that strategies are executed to transform projections into scalable growth for clients. You will communicate performance, strategy adjustments, and key optimizations with clients transparently, reinforcing CTC as a strategic partner in media acquisition and growth planning.

You will set the benchmark for performance marketing, advocating for best-in-class strategies and tools to drive outstanding results. You will operate with efficiency, scalability, and a results-focused mindset, embracing challenges and owning outcomes.

Responsibilities

  • Drive client success through strategic media buying, precision optimization, and data-driven forecasting.
  • Develop accurate Growth Maps and Prophet System-based forecasts; turn projections into tangible, scalable client growth.
  • Maintain proactive, clear, and transparent client communications about performance, strategy changes, and optimizations.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., Google Strategy, Creative Strategy, Email Strategy) to align on growth plans and data integrity.
  • Monitor campaigns, adjust budgets and strategies to maximize daily and projected targets; implement tests to beat prior performance.
  • Lead the execution of CTC’s methodologies, tools, and best practices across client accounts.
  • Hold yourself and the team to high standards of quality, accuracy (within defined deltas), and timely delivery.

What Success Looks Like

  • High accuracy in forecasting (within a 5% delta) and consistent achievement of daily/projected targets.
  • Strong client satisfaction with transparent reporting and strategic guidance.
  • Effective collaboration and knowledge sharing across teams to improve processes and outcomes.

Necessary Skills

  • Autodidact mindset: curiosity, rapid self-learning, and proactive self-direction.
  • Exceptional communication, with the ability to present ideas clearly and persuasively to stakeholders; fluency in English.
  • Strong data analysis capabilities; comfortable with data tools and spreadsheets; willingness to advance skills on the job.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Experience in e-commerce or growth roles involving media buying, data analysis, or operations; ability to contribute to strategy and growth planning.
  • Demonstrated critical thinking, problem-solving, and ownership of outcomes without relying on constant oversight.
  • Adaptability to changing conditions and a track record of delivering results under pressure.

Location & Work Style

  • Fully remote with flexible scheduling and regular 1:1 feedback sessions; autonomous and accountable work environment.

Compensation and Growth

  • Salary progression: Month 1 $2,000; Month 2 $4,000; Month 3 average $7,000; Year 1: $64,000–$76,000; Year 2: $100,000–$120,000. Amounts may vary based on client load and performance.
  • Growth, transparency, and fairness in career development with defined progression paths and weekly performance dashboards.

Note: This role is client-facing and involves direct collaboration with stakeholders to drive growth outcomes.

description:
Analista de Inteligência de Suprimentos/Master Data Sênior

Join to apply for the Analista de Inteligência de Suprimentos/Master Data Sênior role at Rio Energy

Será responsável pelo gerenciamento dos processos de análise de dados de compras com objetivo de identificar oportunidades de melhoria do processo e otimização da cadeia de suprimentos. As principais responsabilidades incluem análises de dados de compras, a identificação de oportunidades para melhorar a eficiência e a redução de custos, a criação de relatórios que apoiam a tomada de decisão da Rio Energy e o gerenciamento e manutenção do master data de suprimentos. Oferecerá apoio à liderança nos processos de homologação e cadastro de fornecedores e itens no SAP, diligência de fornecedores e na construção e acompanhamento orçamentário da área.

Principais Desafios

  • Implementar um sistema de E-procurement, que gerencie os dados e processos de compra, e seja integrado ao ERP;
  • Estruturar as categorias de compras e um processo de Supplier Relationship Management (gestão e avaliação de fornecedores);
  • Elaborar um framework de análise preditiva de Grandes Contratos, com o uso de indicadores de mercado;
  • Estar atento ao mercado na busca de novas soluções tecnológicas que apoiem, tanto na tomada de decisões da RE como no aprimoramento das atividades de rotina da área;
  • Análise contínua dos indicadores da área, garantindo cumprimento dos SLAs previstos nos procedimentos vigentes.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Cumprir e assegurar o cumprimento das políticas e procedimentos da Rio Energy;
  • Auxiliar na elaboração de procedimentos e políticas de trabalho de Suprimentos;
  • Dar o suporte necessário aos compradores e requisitantes sobre o processo de compra, além de realizar treinamentos constantes com as áreas;
  • Acompanhar e alinhar com o Compliance para o processo de Due Diligence de Fornecedores, supervisionando o processo desde a coleta de dados e informações em diversas fontes prévio ao cadastro do fornecedor no ERP, garantindo integridade do que será registrado na plataforma e a aplicação das melhores práticas no processo;
  • Supervisionar o processo de cadastro de fornecedores, garantindo que as informações estejam em constante revisão, com objetivo de mantê-las sempre atualizadas, conforme política vigente;
  • Gerir o sistema de cadastro de itens no SAP, e apoiar a Controladoria no cadastro de ativos fixos;
  • Realizar análises detalhadas dos gastos com materiais, identificação de padrões de compra e consumo, para subsidiar a criação de contratos guarda chuva e estratégias de aquisição eficientes;
  • Suportar a equipe de Compras de forma a garantir o atendimento das necessidades de manutenção e aumentar a disponibilidade dos sites da Rio Energy;
  • Desenvolver relações internas fortes e eficazes com todos os níveis da empresa, para garantir que as necessidades da empresa estejam refletidas na documentação contratual;
  • Desenvolver e alimentar os principais KPIs da área.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação em Engenharia, Economia, Logística, Suprimentos, Administração ou áreas afins.
  • Já ter atuado com implementação de sistemas, entre outras atividades relacionadas à área de Suprimentos.
  • Já ter atuado na área de Suprimentos em empresas do segmento de Energia, é um diferencial.
  • Conhecimento do SAP B1 também é um diferencial.
  • Domínio das ferramentas de dados (Excel, VBA, PowerBI).
  • Domínio na elaboração de apresentações e materiais executivos.
  • Inglês intermediário.

Informações adicionais

  • Local de Atuação: Rio de Janeiro - Bairro Jardim Botânico - Brasil
  • Formato Híbrido

title: Media Buyer & Ad Operations Success Manager (Remote)
description:
Overview

MonetizeMore is a leading ad-tech company dedicated to empowering digital publishers to maximize their ad revenue through innovative technology and strategic partnerships. Our cutting-edge platform optimizes ad layouts, leverages header bidding, and integrates advanced analytics to drive superior results for publishers worldwide. Headquartered in Canada with a strong presence in the APAC region, we’re looking for a dynamic Commissioned Sales Representative to join our high-performing team and help publishers thrive in the digital advertising ecosystem.

Job Overview

We are looking for a Media Buyer & Ad Operations Success Manager who excels in both programmatic/media buying and ad tech operations. This role is critical in ensuring the success of our advertising campaigns by optimizing media investments, managing ad tech infrastructure, and driving performance through data-driven strategies.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in media buying (paid social, programmatic, search, or video) and a deep understanding of ad serving, tracking, and campaign troubleshooting. You will bridge the gap between media execution and technical ad ops, ensuring seamless campaign delivery and maximizing ROI.

Key Responsibilities

  • Media Buying & Optimization:
    • Plan, execute, and optimize performance-driven media buys across platforms (Meta, Google, DSPs, etc.).
    • Manage budgets, bids, and targeting strategies to maximize campaign performance.
    • Conduct A/B testing, audience segmentation, and funnel optimization.
  • Ad Operations & Technical Management:
    • Oversee ad trafficking, tag implementation (Google Tag Manager, pixels, etc.), and QA.
    • Troubleshoot discrepancies in delivery, tracking, or attribution.
    • Collaborate with internal teams and vendors to resolve technical issues.
  • Performance Analysis & Reporting:
    • Monitor KPIs (CTR, CPA, ROAS) and provide actionable insights.
    • Generate reports and present findings to stakeholders.
    • Ensure alignment between media spend and business objectives.
  • Client & Stakeholder Success:
    • Act as a trusted advisor to internal teams or clients on best practices.
    • Proactively identify opportunities for campaign improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Analytical Thinking - Ability to interpret data, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions.
  • Technical Proficiency - Familiarity with digital advertising tools and platforms like Google Ad Manager, WordPress, GAM 360, traffic acquisition tools such as Active Campaign and header bidding solutions.
  • Problem-Solving Skills - Resourceful in identifying issues, troubleshooting errors, and finding effective solutions.
  • Attention to Detail - Precision in setting up campaigns, implementing ad tags, or managing publisher configurations to ensure optimal outcomes.
  • Communication Skills - Clarity in conveying technical details, results, and strategies to stakeholders with varying levels of understanding.
  • Client-Centric Mindset - Strong focus on understanding client needs and providing personalized solutions to maximize client satisfaction.
  • Knowledge of Ad Metrics - Understanding of key ad metrics like CPM, CPC, CTR, RPM, and ad yield optimization strategies.
  • Strategic Thinking - Ability to think ahead and align short-term actions with long-term goals, including scaling performance.
  • Sales Acumen - Skills to pitch ad solutions effectively, negotiate deals, and close partnerships with publishers or advertisers.
  • Results-Oriented - Strong drive to achieve and exceed KPIs and revenue targets.
  • Negotiation Skills - Confidence in negotiating with clients, vendors, and partners to secure the best outcomes for the business.
  • Resilience - Ability to handle challenges and setbacks while maintaining motivation and a positive attitude.
  • Data Visualization - Skills to create clear and impactful reports or dashboards to communicate performance and insights effectively.
  • AI Fluency - Understanding and practical application of AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, data enrichment tools, automated workflows) to enhance productivity, decision-making, and campaign performance.

If you think you are a good fit to join the MonetizeMore team, please fill out the application. Also, give specific reasons on what sets you apart. We hire individuals, not robots so don’t be afraid to show a little personality ;)

Overview

Country Operations Manager – LATAM

Job Type: Full-time contract

Trantor Inc. is a global technology services and consulting company headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with delivery centers across the USA, Canada, and India. We partner with Fortune 500 companies and high-growth enterprises to drive digital transformation through Product Engineering, Cloud Enablement, Data & AI Solutions, Automation, and Customer Success Services. At Trantor, we thrive in a collaborative, agile, and people-first environment.

Why Join Trantor?

Trantor offers the opportunity to work on diverse, cutting-edge projects in a culture that values innovation, continuous learning, and collaboration. Enjoy the flexibility of a remote role while contributing to impactful initiatives in a truly global organization.

Opportunity Summary

We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Country Manager – LATAM to lead and scale our operations across the region. This role is 80% operations-focused , with responsibility for resource management, workforce planning, employee engagement, HR, HR compliance, and strategic growth . The remaining 20% requires technical acumen to manage tech people, understand how tech operations are run, and participate in technical discussions with clients.

The right candidate will have proven experience in managing, scaling, and setting up IT/Tech teams , ensuring smooth delivery and operational excellence. They must be adept at building and inspiring high-performing teams , driving compliance and retention , and cultivating trusted long-term relationships with clients and stakeholders.

What’s Exciting About This Role?

  • Lead and shape our entire LATAM operation, with the autonomy to make high-impact decisions.
  • Build and inspire a high-performing, multicultural team while forging strong client relationships.
  • Play a pivotal role in driving operational excellence and market presence.
  • Work in a fast-paced, global environment where your ideas are implemented, not just discussed.

Key Responsibilities

  • HR & Resource Management
    Oversee all LATAM resources to ensure productivity and quality.
  • Manage the full employee lifecycle including hiring, onboarding, HR compliance, and performance management.
  • Monitor attrition rates and implement proactive retention strategies.
  • Drive employee satisfaction through engagement programs, career development, and structured feedback channels.
  • Tech Operations Oversight
    Manage and scale tech operations and delivery teams.
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical delivery.
  • Provide credible oversight in technical discussions with clients.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders and customers across LATAM.
  • Act as the primary liaison for client needs, service delivery, and customer success.
  • Represent the company at local and regional events, forums, and client meetings.
  • Operational Leadership & Strategic Growth
    Lead daily operations, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and alignment with corporate policies.
  • Collaborate with HR, Finance, and global teams for seamless cross-functional workflows.
  • Monitor performance metrics and provide regular updates to regional/global leadership.
  • Adapt and execute market-specific strategies aligned with global objectives.
  • Financial & Market Insight Contribution
    Support budget planning, resource allocation, and cost optimization.
  • Provide local market intelligence to inform global strategic decisions.

Key Qualifications & Skills

  • Experience: 8–12 years in senior leadership or country management, preferably in the IT/Consulting sector.
  • People & HR Management: Proven success in leading teams, driving workforce planning, employee engagement, HR processes, and HR compliance , with measurable improvement in retention.
  • Tech Operations Oversight: Demonstrated ability to set up, scale, and manage IT/Tech teams (Must Have)
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Strong track record in building trusted relationships with clients, partners, and internal stakeholders.
  • Strategic & Operational Skills: Ability to translate business objectives into actionable operational and delivery plans, while ensuring compliance and efficiency.
  • Communication: Fluency in English (written and spoken) is required; Spanish and Portuguese proficiency are strong advantages.
  • Technical Tools: Familiarity with CRM systems, business management platforms, and performance reporting tools.

Why Join Us?

  • Strategic leadership role with direct impact on our LATAM operations
  • Competitive remuneration (salary only)
  • Work within a global and fast-growing organization
  • Friendly, supportive, positive, and professional team of experts
  • Multicultural and diverse environment
  • Remote work conditions
